pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Semgrep is a fast, lightweight static analysis tool for finding bugs, enforcing code standards, and detecting security vulnerabilities in many languages using pattern-based rules that look like the source code itself.
This package installs Semgrep from the official prebuilt PyPI wheel, including the Python CLI, native semgrep-core engine, and bundled shared libraries. The ebuild repairs the binary RUNPATH and integrates the wheel into Gentoo's Python installation. It does not build semgrep-core from OCaml source, and it does not depend on a separate semgrep-core package.
The dependency graph also uses OpenTelemetry instrumentation and threading instrumentation from ::guru, plus httpx-sse and sse-starlette through mcp. The local HTTP exporter revision repairs missing direct dependencies. Click 8.5.0 and OpenTelemetry 1.45.1/0.66b1 are tested downstream compatibility choices; they exceed Semgrep's declared upstream bounds. The installed wheel metadata is adjusted to the same narrow baseline.
